findings.counterevidence: Frozen machine-search scopes and counts are unchanged: OFR catalog plus 7619 saved texts provides four hits, cutoff eCFR zero hits, no current-law leads and no dossier missing entries. The stated-effective-date conflict is expressly resolved from EO:11948 sections 3 and 5. U.S. Code release ending October 9 2026 is not selected as cutoff proof. Bounded searches support historical termination, not an exhaustive universal no-revival assertion.
findings.earlier_ends: Full EO:11873 immediately replaces section 2 in full on 1975-07-21, increasing congressional membership from two to four per chamber. Full EO:11936 immediately replaces section 4(c) in full on 1976-09-08. Neither has delayed effect. The two original-wording first ends remain distinct from later termination of their replacement arrangements; each retains the Jan 16 1977 revocation as a later event.
findings.effective_revocation: Full EO:11948 section 3 specifically revokes EO:11868 as amended effective 1977-01-16. That target-specific date controls over section 5 general 1976-12-31 effect and 1976-12-20 execution. It ends the remaining twelve original clauses and supplies the latest clause first end, so whole_order_end 1977-01-16 is supported.
findings.inventory: The complete frozen official extracted original was reread. Fourteen corrected original spans still cover every operative section 1-8 and subsection; omitted interstitial content is page furniture and the section 8 editorial note. All derived clause spans and available dossier evidence spans match actual held text and text hashes. Original and all three full official acting texts are byte-identical to the previously read local sources.
findings.new_evidence: Additional full-run official variants repeat the same immediate replacements and target-specific revocation. The newly embedded APP transcription agrees on dates but is not substituted for official evidence. Four unused records have three missing local cache paths; their complete embedded provisions repeat already verified official report deadlines, amendment direction and revocation. They reveal no unexamined material new event. Selected assembled references use only the four available official full_run sources.
findings.own_terms: All four own-term records were read. Added records duplicate the original five-month first-report and seven-month second-report deadlines. These and EO:11936 January 15 1977 replacement deadline require performance, without automatic cessation. No actual report submission/completion or prior Commission sunset is inferred. No new earlier actor or substantive cessation event appears in the frozen three-event chain.
findings.savings: Original sections 5-8 advisory committees, HEW services/funding, compensation/travel and FACA administration all depend on this Commission. Full texts of all actors contain no independent saved command, transfer or target-specific savings. No particular accrued liability is established or extinguished; prospective authority termination does not decide accrued reimbursement.
findings.source_quality: Frozen original grade is original_representation_unverified and location_verified false, while acceptable_as_original true, high location confidence and requires_page_check false remain. Official URL, PDF hash declaration, text hash, exact location and complete extracted text are unchanged. Acceptance records a source-text AI review under those explicit flags; it does not assert PDF-image authentication or independent binary custody. No page-image inspection was performed.
